stats.label: Teams — and not a single extra

features.title: Operator inside your team
features.body: No lectures. Your own tracker and mentors who have built and sold themselves work with you every week: workshops, personal office hours, analysis of your metrics. Plus office, experts, and lawyers — for free.

features.title: Public ranking
features.body: Every Monday, all teams' numbers are visible to everyone. Traction weighs twice as much as everything else, beautiful slides count for nothing. Inflated numbers — ban, repeated — expulsion.

features.title: Investment for results
features.body: $10,000 to $100,000 over 40 days — for teams that reached revenue and customers. Decision by numbers. Teams without results get nothing.

notACourse.heading: This is not a course.

forYou.body: You've already invested your own time or money in the idea — and will build it with us or without us.
You're ready for 40 days of full commitment and for your numbers to be visible to everyone every week.
You need partners who argue, not applaud.

notForYou.body: You came for free office space, mentorship, or a certificate.
Your idea is just a pitch, and you're waiting for permission to start.
You're counting on advance funding. Here, investment must be earned.

notACourse.verdictLead: Almost every rejection comes down to one thing:
notACourse.verdictAccent: the founder wanted the program more than the company.

cta.body: The application takes 2–3 hours. Show us what you've already created and what you've learned from customers. This is the first filter.

footer.tagline: The simplest idea becomes the strongest

body: The application takes 2–3 hours. That's on purpose: it's the program's first filter. Answer concretely — names, numbers, links. Pretty phrasing isn't scored, the work you've done is.
Fill in the form in one sitting: if you close the window, your entries won't be saved.

steps.title: Team
steps.sublabel: Who else is on the team? Name, role, commitment (full/part-time). If you're solo — just say so, it's not a minus.
steps.placeholder: For example: Alisa (design, full-time), Botir (marketing, part-time)

steps.title: Your startup in one sentence
steps.sublabel: What do you do, for whom, and why is it better than what exists? One sentence.
steps.placeholder: For example: A CRM for taxi drivers that automates orders and keeps real-time accounting.

steps.title: Customer and access to them
steps.sublabel: Who is your customer — a specific role, segment? And how will you reach the first 10 people this very month — channels, places, contacts?
steps.placeholder: For example: Customer: Tashkent taxi drivers (25–45, self-employed). Access: Yandex Go forum, local driver chats, my uncle knows 3 drivers.

steps.title: What's already done
steps.sublabel: What have you built, spent or sold for this idea? Be specific: hours, money, a prototype link, number of customers or conversations. "Nothing yet" is an honest answer too.
steps.placeholder: For example: Spent 60 hours on a prototype, 500k soum on Figma and hosting. Showed it to 8 drivers, three liked it.

steps.title: Last three conversations with customers
steps.sublabel: Write your last three conversations with real potential customers: who you spoke to (role), what exactly they said, what you understood. If there were none — say so honestly and explain who you'll talk to this week.
steps.placeholder:
For example:
1. Akbar (driver): "I lose a whole day tracking trips right now." → Understood: there's a real problem, automation is needed.
2. Samarbek: "I have an Excel sheet, but it has errors." → could be a customer, but needs to see it first.
3. Haven't spoken yet. I'll reach Nina via Telegram this week.

steps.title: First revenue
steps.sublabel: Where does the first money come from in the next 6 months? Who pays, why, first price.
steps.placeholder: Drivers pay $2/month for automation. First customer — my acquaintance Akbar (starts in September).

steps.title: If we reject you
steps.sublabel: If we reject you, what will you do?
steps.placeholder: I'll build it anyway. I've already arranged hosting for September, raised $1,500 for marketing, and scheduled 20 conversations for the summer.

steps.title: Terms of participation
options: I understand: 40 days is offline full-time, with no parallel work or study.
I follow the open-leaderboard and honest-numbers rule: inflated metrics — ban, repeat — removal.
I understand: before day one — pre-work, 5 customer conversations by template.
I understand: the $10–100K investment is at the end and by result, not guaranteed and with no advance.
steps.note: Each checkbox is a psychological and legal confirmation. Those who aren't ready drop off here, before the interview.

steps.title: Video · 2 minutes
steps.sublabel: Record 2 minutes with no editing, a phone camera is enough, in any of the three languages. Two questions: why should you specifically solve this problem? What have you done in the last 30 days to get closer to a solution?

video.label: Video
video.dropTitle: Choose a file or drop it here

success.title: Application received
success.body: Thank you! We've received your application. It's now under review. Once the review is complete, we'll let you know the result.

errors.checklist: Confirm all the terms to continue
errors.video: Upload a video file or add a link
errors.submit: Could not send your application. Check your connection and try again.
